title: Sub-Cycle Bus-Phase Accuracy Matching VICE x64sc Behavior
body: Managed C64 PAL execution must preserve C64 bus, CPU, and VIC-II ordering semantics while optimizing RunFrame so performance changes do not alter cycle-observable behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Lockstep and checkpoint suites continue to pass after RunFrame performance optimizations.
